EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST 2. EthSwt_PortLinkStateRequest with ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE, only if current link state is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN

Everytime EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode has been called with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE _WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, EthIf shall forward the call for all EthSwtPorts of the respective EthIfSwitchPortGroup to the following functions in the given order independent of the current EthSwtPort mode: 1. EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST 2. EthSwt_PortLinkStateRequest with ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE, only if current link state is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN

Everytime EthIf_SwitchPortGroupRequestMode has been called with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST , EthIf shall forward the call for all EthSwtPorts of the respective EthIfSwitchPortGroup to the following functions in the given order independent of the current EthSwtPort mode: 1. EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_RE- QUEST 2. EthSwt_PortLinkStateRequest with ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE , only if current link state is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN
